summary.text: One of the earthborn Giants whom Athena flayed in the Gigantomachy and whose skin she used to shield her own body in the fight.

story.text: Apollodorus names Pallas among the Giants destroyed when Heracles fought at the gods' side: Athena flayed Pallas and used his skin to shield her own body in the fight. The collective node `gigantes` holds the earthborn revolt; this node is the individual in the battle roster.
The atlas keeps this Pallas distinct from the Titan `pallas`, son of Crius and Eurybia, and from `pallas-pandionid`, the son of Pandion.
